sourceState: Scheduling Wave A: the bounded RRULE expansion engine and derived due-queue query ported verbatim (19 + 6 pinned cases green under their pinned names), plus the writer-lane-authored source-agnostic due-occurrence seam (IDueOccurrenceSource / RruleDueOccurrenceSource / CompositeDueOccurrenceSource, 3 seam tests) required by the user ruling of 2026-08-16 so the ticket-086 relative-chain generator lands behind the same port later. T-1197/bounded-expansion (interface revision 8) bounds one chronological Ical.Net-backed walk, including empty recurrence periods, with 50000 work units; Scheduling checks 3660 requested local dates and reuses that walk for override membership (control rulings 1371/1372).
